title: Emotion Geometry in the KV Cache
subtitle: Emotion readout through W_K projection and injection disambiguation in the KV cache
abstract: Language models maintain internal representations of user emotional state readable from the KV cache---not through aggregate spectral features (which fail under proper controls), but through directional alignment with emotion vectors projected through the key weight matrix W_K. Projecting key activations onto W_K-transformed emotion directions classifies 30 emotions at 12.3x chance and binary valence at AUROC 0.992 (within-fold FWL-corrected, topic-grouped CV, n=900). Injecting emotion vectors into neutral-text caches proves the signal is model state, not text content (100% detection on text with zero emotional content). Spectral features are null after proper controls: emotions change the direction key vectors point, not the spectral shape of the cache. The W_K bridge maps residual-stream emotion vectors into a valence-separated cache subspace (rho=0.862).
